basic_details.job_title: TISS Sarala Das Memorial Post-Doc Fellowship Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Mumbai, in collaboration with Odisha Research Centre (ORC), Bhubaneswar, offers one Sarala Das Memorial Post-Doc Fellowship on the research theme "Temple Economy of Odisha". The fellowship lasts one year and carries a consolidated Rs. 60,000 per month. Applicants need a Ph.D. in a listed or allied discipline awarded between 2021 and 2026, and proficiency in Odia writing and speaking is mandatory. Applications are online through the Apply now link on www.tiss.ac.in, and the last date is 23 November 2026.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid online. For those required to pay, the application is valid only on receipt of the fee. Fees once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances.

how_to_apply: Open the Apply now link provided with the advertisement on the Institute website www.tiss.ac.in.
Fill in the online application form with the desired information and documents as per the advertisement.
SC/ST/PwD candidates claiming the Rs 125/- fee attach the required Certificate to the online form.
Pay the application fee online, unless exempted as a woman applicant.
Submit the application on or before 23 November 2026.
Take a print of the acknowledgement of the online application and keep it for future reference.

content_sections.heading: TISS Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application start date.

rows.details: Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Mumbai, in collaboration with Odisha Research Centre (ORC), Bhubaneswar
Sarala Das Memorial Post-Doc Fellowship based in Odisha Research Centre (ORC), Bhubaneswar
Consolidated Salary of Rs. 60,000 per month
Rs 500/-; Rs 125/- for SC/ST/PwD; women exempted

content_sections.heading: About TISS
content_sections.text: The notice describes TISS as a Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act 1956 and a grant-in-aid institute under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, with its office at V.N. Purav Marg, Deonar, Mumbai - 400 088. It names four campuses: Mumbai (Main campus), Hyderabad, Guwahati and Tuljapur (rural campus). ORC, Bhubaneswar, is described as an ICSSR grant-in-aid research institute that carries out interdisciplinary research on Odisha's society, history, culture, economy, ecology and development.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants should possess a Ph.D. in History/Economics/Sociology/Anthropology/Culture Studies/Religious Studies/Public Policy or any allied discipline from a recognised university, awarded between 2021 to 2026. The notice does not print an age limit. The position is unreserved, but candidates belonging to a reserved category are encouraged to apply. Candidates must assess their own eligibility, and the decision of TISS is final in case of any ambiguity about eligibility. For further detail, candidates should check the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D. in the disciplines above or an allied discipline, from a recognised university, awarded between 2021 to 2026; proficiency in Odia writing and speaking is mandatory
rows.desirable: Demonstrated interest in Odishan studies, temple institutions, economy, society, history, archival work and field-based research

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship pays a consolidated Rs. 60,000 per month and its tenure is one year. Selected candidates have to join within 15 days of intimation of selection. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview if the interviews are held at the Institute's premises.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid online. For those required to pay, the application is valid only on receipt of the fee. Fees once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances.

rows.category: SC/ST/PwD candidates, if they attach the required Certificate to the online Application Form

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received will be shortlisted, so possessing the prescribed qualifications does not entitle a person to be called for interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed over e-mail and/or mobile phone to appear for the interview. The notice does not give an interview date or venue. No queries or correspondence about the call letter or selection will be entertained at any stage.
